description: Source file implementing classes and methods related to shader uniform variables in the ANGLE graphics library, including ActiveVariable, LinkedUniform, BufferVariable, ShaderVariableBuffer, and InterfaceBlock.

classes.name: ActiveVariable
classes.description: Represents an active variable in a shader, tracking usage across shader types.

classes.name: LinkedUniform
classes.description: Represents a linked uniform variable with type, name, array sizes, and block info.

classes.name: BufferVariable
classes.description: Represents a buffer variable with type, name, array sizes, and block info.

classes.name: ShaderVariableBuffer
classes.description: Represents a shader variable buffer with binding and data size.

classes.name: InterfaceBlock
classes.description: Represents an interface block with name, array info, and binding.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets whether a shader type is active for the variable.

methods.name: unionReferencesWith
methods.description: Unions the reference bits with another ActiveVariable.

methods.name: getFirstShaderTypeWhereActive
methods.description: Returns the first shader type where the variable is active.

methods.name: activeShaderCount
methods.description: Returns the count of active shader types.

methods.name: nameWithArrayIndex
methods.description: Returns the name of the interface block with array index if applicable.

methods.name: mappedNameWithArrayIndex
methods.description: Returns the mapped name of the interface block with array index if applicable.
